verdict.rationale: Figma's own docs describe an AI agent that can 'generate new design directions,' 'edit images,' and even 'generate designs from live UI' or diagrams from prompts (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34, figma-docs-5, figma-docs-6, figma-docs-22), which directly matches the story of prompt-driven mockup/layout generation. However, this is entirely first-party marketing copy with no independent or hands-on validation of quality, and one community report explicitly calls the AI tools in the related FigJam product 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), casting doubt on real-world reliability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that the Figma agent actually produces usable first drafts or full mockups, and resolution of the reported brokenness of adjacent AI features.
